Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

think verb

believe that, hold an opinion

also I think, suppose, in my opinion, what do you think?, I suppose (parenthetical), I take it

classical

Catull. 12.4: hoc salsum esse putās?
Cic. Fam. 9.3.1: quod velle tē putō

putō, putāre, putāvī, putātum

verb, first conjugation

think, suppose

With an accusative and infinitive. In Cicero’s letters putō also stands alone as an aside, “I think”; Nōn putāram is “I never thought of that” (Cic. Off. 1.81).

Other words

  • opīnor, opīnārī, opīnātus sum — think, suppose

    verb, first conjugation, deponent · also used · classical · Cic. Tusc. 1.92: nōndum, opīnor, est experrēctus

    Most often as an aside, opīnor or ut opīnor, “I think”, “I suppose”. For Sīc opīnor see I think so.

  • arbitror, arbitrārī, arbitrātus sum — think, judge

    verb, first conjugation, deponent · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 13.49.1: quam equidem rūrī esse arbitror

    A considered judgement; also as an aside, ut arbitror.

  • cēnseō, cēnsēre, cēnsuī, cēnsum — think, be of the opinion; think it best

    verb, second conjugation · also used · classical · Plaut. Ps. 664–665: Sānē cēnseō.; Cic. de Or. 2.367: surgendum cēnseō et requiēscendum; Traupman 109: quid cēnsēs?, what do you think?

    Quid cēnsēs? asks “What do you think?”; with a gerundive it gives advice: surgendum cēnseō, I think we should get up.

  • ut opīnor — I suppose, I take it (parenthetical)

    parenthetical clause · also used · classical · Cic. Fl. 27: namque, ut opīnor, Asia vestra cōnstat ex Phrygiā … (Lewis & Short); Traupman 108, 109

Examples

  • hoc salsum esse putās? fugit tē, inepte

    You think that’s funny? You’ve got it wrong, silly.Catull. 12.4

  • quid ergō potissimum scrībam? quod velle tē putō, citō mē ad tē esse ventūrum

    So what shall I write above all? What I think you want: that I’ll be with you soon.Cic. Fam. 9.3.1

  • nec committere, ut aliquandō dīcendum sit: Nōn putāram.

    and not to let it come to having to say, “I never thought of that.”Cic. Off. 1.81

See also I think so, I don’t think so, think, mind, believe.
